media.title: Andrzej Włast — portrait
media.description: Portrait photograph of Andrzej Włast (Gustaw Baumritter), poet and lyricist, one of interwar Warsaw's most prolific revue and cabaret song authors and an early collaborator of Bronisław Kaper. Source metadata: Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe / Szukaj w Archiwach, unit 5929697, object 264116.
